_note: THE PILOT'S WHEEL RULE, WRITTEN ONTO THE CARDS FORGE PLAYS (2026-10-21). captain's log 002: 'those should be finisher kind of things ... Shabraz and Brallin are already out, they're kind of big, and I'm gonna drop a wheel on them'. The goldfish reads the same sentence from pilot_policy.json (rule wheel-is-a-finisher); Forge reads it here, as a NeedsToPlay hold on each wheel — the engine's cast gate honours it for any spell or ability (ComputerUtilCard.checkNeedsToPlayReqs, 2.0.14) and DiscardAi then fires the wheel in the first Main 2 it can afford. A hold is one-directional: it stops a cast, it does not cause one. 2026-10-22: equip-on-commander and attack hints (EquipMe, HasAttackEffect, AttachAi) for the voltron branch; Brotherhood Regalia (a restricted second Equip keyword) and Lizard Blades (Reconfigure ignores AttachAi) rely on the commanders' EquipMe. 2026-10-25: Wheel of Fortune (commander gate, author's NeedsToPlayVar dropped), Incendiary Command (commander gate on the whole card, the pilot's call) and Jeskai Ascendancy (PlayMain1) for answers-v1 and the seat-audit fail. Same date: hints for five cards no longer in the 99 or an open branch (Echo of Eons, Magus of the Wheel, Molten Psyche, Swiftfoot Boots, Thought Vessel) removed — the gate had failed on them since they were cut; git history keeps them. 2026-11-04: hints for nine cards no longer in the 99 or an open branch (Alhammarret's Archive, Silence, Khorvath's Fury, Talisman of Conviction, Champion's Helm, Fireshrieker, Genji Glove, Mask of Memory, Zephyr Boots) and the Ghostly Pilferer floor removed: `validate-forge-hints` had failed on them since v2.1.0 and v2.2.0 cut them, and `forge-install --generate` refuses a file that fails it. Git history keeps them. 2026-11-06: Jeskai Ascendancy, Embercleave and the March of Swirling Mist floor removed — cut in v2.3.0 (draw-engine-v1).
